import csv, duckdb
path = 'blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv'
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(path)))
oracle_rows = len(rows)
oracle_total_volume = sum(int(r['volume']) for r in rows)
oracle_by_symbol = {}
for r in rows:
    oracle_by_symbol[r['symbol']] = oracle_by_symbol.get(r['symbol'], 0) + int(r['volume'])
oracle_max_high = max(float(r['high']) for r in rows)
oracle_min_low = min(float(r['low']) for r in rows)

con.read_csv(path, header=True, columns={'symbol':'VARCHAR','session':'DATE','open':'DOUBLE','high':'DOUBLE','low':'DOUBLE','close':'DOUBLE','volume':'BIGINT','observed_at':'TIMESTAMP'}).create_view('bars')
n = con.sql('SELECT count(*) FROM bars').fetchone()[0]
total_vol = con.sql('SELECT sum(volume) FROM bars').fetchone()[0]
by_symbol = dict(con.sql('SELECT symbol, sum(volume) FROM bars GROUP BY symbol').fetchall())
max_high = con.sql('SELECT max(high) FROM bars').fetchone()[0]
min_low = con.sql('SELECT min(low) FROM bars').fetchone()[0]

D=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT && /usr/bin/timeout 120 bwrap --unshare-net --die-with-parent --ro-bind / / --bind "$D" "$D" --dev /dev --proc /proc "$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/sdk-py313/bin/python" -s -c "
import csv, duckdb, hashlib, os, sys
path = 'blueprints/us-equities/data/fixtures/good.csv'
out = os.path.join(sys.argv[1], 'bars.parquet')
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(path)))
oracle_rows = len(rows)
oracle_total_volume = sum(int(r['volume']) for r in rows)
con = duckdb.connect()
con.read_csv(path, header=True, columns={'symbol':'VARCHAR','session':'DATE','open':'DOUBLE','high':'DOUBLE','low':'DOUBLE','close':'DOUBLE','volume':'BIGINT','observed_at':'TIMESTAMP'}).write_parquet(out, compression='zstd')
reread = con.read_parquet(out)
reread.create_view('reread_bars')
n = con.sql('SELECT count(*) FROM reread_bars').fetchone()[0]
total_vol = con.sql('SELECT sum(volume) FROM reread_bars').fetchone()[0]
parquet_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(open(out, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()
ok = n == oracle_rows == 4 and total_vol == oracle_total_volume == 146008800 and os.path.getsize(out) > 0
print('parquet round trip rows', n, 'oracle rows', oracle_rows, '| reread total_volume', total_vol, 'oracle total_volume', oracle_total_volume, '| parquet bytes', os.path.getsize(out), '| parquet_sha256', parquet_sha256, '| match', ok)
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
" "$D"
